description: Replace the authorization code on an inbound transfer that stalled because the code was wrong, and re-queue it — instead of cancelling, refunding and resubmitting. The new code is validated against the registry before being stored, so a bad one is rejected here rather than failing again days later. Only repairable transfers qualify; others return TRANSFER_NOT_REPAIRABLE. Note that a losing registrar's refusal also surfaces as a bad-auth-code status, so check for a denial notice before assuming the code is the problem.

auth_code.description: Replacement authorization (EPP) code from the losing registrar.

domain.description: Domain with the stalled inbound transfer.

dry_run.description: Validate the code without storing it or re-queueing.

name: update_transfer_auth_code
